configs.mados_only: b_noextra: MADOS train+val minus 13 scenes = same acquisition as MARIDA val; MADOS-only classes (oil spill, oil platform, jellyfish, sea snot) -> unlabelled; seeds 0/1/2

final_weights: weights_exp/mados/final (combined c_noextra_exclplace, seed 0: F1 0.9226, IoU 0.8564, threshold 0.63)
reason: combined F1 MD val 0.9228 +- 0.0005 >= 0.906 + max(0.01, 2*0.0025) = 0.916 (also mados_only 0.9206 passes; combined chosen as best and most stable). Gain comes from fewer false positives (FP 104 -> 74 at the same recall). Only with MADOS-only classes mapped to unlabelled (strict MARIDA scheme); with them as negatives combined = 0.9153 < 0.916 (not accepted). Caveats: 12 configurations were compared on the same val (selection optimism ~0.001-0.002, well below the margin); on L2A (Durban, 46 MD px) raw recall 24/46 vs 33/46 for weights/lgbm, with harmonize water_median(SCL) 36/46 vs 27/46.
